UPDATE jobs
        SET status = CASE
                WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN 'dead'
                ELSE 'pending'
            END,
            run_at = CASE
                WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN run_at
                ELSE now() + make_interval(
                    secs => LEAST(300.0, power(2.0, attempts)) * (0.75 + random() * 0.5)
                )
            END,
            finished_at = CASE
                WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN now()
                ELSE NULL
            END,
            last_error = $3,
            locked_by = NULL,
            locked_until = NULL,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = $1
          AND status = 'running'
          AND locked_by = $2
